en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Slovakia–Czech Republic treaty provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling where the beneficial owner holds at least 10 per cent of the payer’s capital and a 15 per cent ceiling in the other treaty case. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Slovakia–Czech Republic treaty provides residence-State-only taxation for interest beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State, subject to the permanent-establishment effective-connection exception and the treaty’s arm’s-length limitation. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Slovakia–Czech Republic treaty provides residence-State-only taxation for copyright royalties relating to literary, artistic or scientific works including films, broadcast recordings and other audiovisual reproduction other than computer software, and a 10 per cent source-State ceiling for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, computer software, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment and know-how, where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
